As the technology and marine transportation industry is relatively new, special 2 attention will be paid to qualifications and references pertaining to the hoses, sealing systems, and safe design. Rail and road transport of CO is more established and there are existing technologies that can 2 load / unload cargos onto standard rail / road transport systems. Rail car transportation of pressurized liquid CO is well established in the USA, and standards exist for rail 2 cars and associated fittings. As a result, this assessment has focused on overhead unloading systems in Page59 of158 T-RICH Pre-FEED Report – Public Version line with the Class-105 prohibition on bottom outlets and washouts in these pressurized insulated rail cars. The Pre-FEED basis is to have multipurpose unloading arms for both rail and road cargoes. Though this could be challenged during FEED based upon the anticipated ratio of rail and truck unloading operations, as a savings may be obtained by having dedicated rail and road unloading arms with reduced reach and numbers tailored to the frequency of the various operations. We are pursing two options with respect to the chillers, one being utilizing R-744 (CO ) as a refrigerant, the other a 2 more standard unit utilizing R-32. The chillers will be designed to be suitable for a marine application, which will be required for T-RICH's location.
